metaData.originalTitle: TogetherAI 开源 OSCAR：超越 TurboQuant! 面向真实 Serving 的 2-bit KV Cache 量化
metaData.title: TogetherAI Open Sources OSCAR: Surpassing TurboQuant! 2-bit KV Cache Quantization for Real-World Serving
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Together AI has open-sourced OSCAR, a 2-bit KV Cache quantization scheme designed for real-world long-context serving. By employing attention-aware rotation techniques, it significantly reduces memory footprint and boosts inference throughput while maintaining model performance comparable to BF16 precision.
metaData.summary: This article details Together AI's open-source OSCAR (Offline Spectral Covariance-Aware Rotation) scheme, which aims to solve the KV Cache memory bottleneck in long-context LLM inference. OSCAR's core innovation lies not in simply reconstructing the K/V vectors with low error, but in analyzing the attention mechanism to push quantization noise into directions that are insensitive to attention. Specifically, OSCAR uses query covariance to guide key rotation and score-weighted value covariance to guide value rotation, combined with Hadamard transform and bit-reversal techniques, achieving efficient quantization at approximately 2.28 effective bits per KV element. On the system implementation side, OSCAR has been integrated into SGLang, managing KV Cache with a three-stage token pool (BF16 sink + INT2 history + BF16 recent), and is compatible with paged KV and prefix cache. Evaluation results show that on models like Qwen3 and GLM-4.7, OSCAR's performance at 2-bit precision is close to BF16, improving by up to 40.1 points over 3-bit TurboQuant, achieving up to ~3x decode speedup and up to ~7x job-level throughput improvement. The article also provides a quick practical guide for deploying OSCAR on SGLang.

mainPoints.point: OSCAR uses attention-aware rotation techniques to steer quantization noise towards directions insensitive to attention.
mainPoints.explanation: Unlike traditional methods that aim for low reconstruction error of K/V vectors, OSCAR uses query covariance and score-weighted value covariance to guide the generation of rotation matrices, ensuring that the quantized KV Cache has minimal impact on attention computation.

mainPoints.point: OSCAR achieves performance close to BF16 at approximately 2.28 BPE, significantly outperforming other 2-bit and 3-bit schemes.
mainPoints.explanation: On models like Qwen3-8B, OSCAR shows minimal performance gap compared to BF16 on tasks such as GPQA and HumanEval, and significantly outperforms QuaRot-INT2 and TurboQuant, demonstrating its ability to maintain model quality under high compression rates.

mainPoints.point: OSCAR is integrated into SGLang with a three-stage token pool design, balancing precision and efficiency.
mainPoints.explanation: During runtime, the KV Cache is divided into three segments: BF16 sink, INT2 history, and BF16 recent. This protects the precision of attention sinks and recent context while drastically compressing the memory footprint of historical KV, and is compatible with paged KV and prefix cache.

mainPoints.point: OSCAR delivers significant memory savings and inference acceleration in long-context scenarios.
mainPoints.explanation: Compared to BF16, OSCAR can reduce KV Cache memory by approximately 8x, achieving up to ~3x decode speedup and ~7x job-level throughput improvement under 100k context, making it particularly suitable for Agent scenarios with long prefix reuse.

keyQuotes: OSCAR's core idea is: don't just aim to reconstruct the K/V vectors themselves, but to preserve the way attention truly consumes these KV values.
OSCAR's advantage is not just making the numerical distribution smoother, but pushing quantization noise into directions that are relatively insensitive to attention.
OSCAR doesn't simply 'add a rotation'; it incorporates rotation, clipping, and grouping into the objective function of attention quality.
OSCAR is designed for deployable enterprise workloads, not just to show the paper's bleak error data.

The key insight from OSCAR is: for 2-bit KV Cache to truly go online, rotation must not only 'exist' but be aligned with attention; simultaneously, it must be designed together within a real serving system.

relatedArticles.title: Face Intelligence Open-Sources Two Edge-Side Models: MiniCPM5-1B Beats 2B with 1B Parameters, BitCPM-CANN Unlocks 6x VRAM Efficiency
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Face Intelligence, in collaboration with Tsinghua University, open-sources MiniCPM5-1B and BitCPM-CANN. The former surpasses 2B-level models with just 1B parameters, while the latter achieves 6x VRAM efficiency through 1.58-bit quantization, marking a breakthrough in domestic computing power based on the full Huawei Ascend stack.

relatedArticles.title: Tair and SGLang Jointly Build a Hierarchical Cache Architecture for DeepSeek V4
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the hierarchical cache architecture built by the Alibaba Cloud Tair KVCache team and the SGLang community for DeepSeek V4. Through three core components—Shadow Radix, HiCache, and HiSparse—it addresses the logical description of KV Cache in long-context inference, prefix reuse during the Prefill phase, and GPU memory bottlenecks during the Decode phase, respectively.

relatedArticles.title: MemPrivacy Open-Source: Let Cloud-Edge Agents Remember You Without Handing Over Your Privacy
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: The MemPrivacy open-source project proposes a local reversible pseudonymization scheme that allows cloud-edge agents to protect privacy while almost entirely preserving reasoning and memory capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Kimi's New Paper: Turning KV Cache into a New Business Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI and Tsinghua University jointly propose the Prefill-as-a-Service architecture, which compresses the KV Cache through hybrid attention models, enabling its transmission across data centers via standard Ethernet, thereby achieving geo-distributed heterogeneous scheduling of Prefill and Decode, significantly improving long-context reasoning performance.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaohongshu Open-Sources FireRed-OCR: 2B Parameter Model Tops Document Parsing Leaderboard
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaohongshu has open-sourced the 2B-parameter FireRed-OCR model, which achieves performance surpassing ultra-large-scale general models in document parsing through innovative three-stage training and format-constrained reinforcement learning.

relatedArticles.title: Deep Dive into OpenClaw's Context Window Compression: All for Performance and Cost Savings
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the context window management scheme in the popular AI project OpenClaw, revealing its multi-layered defense system—from preventive pruning and active compaction to overflow recovery—and its cost optimization strategies.

relatedArticles.title: Next-Generation Large Model Inference Network Architecture: How ZCube Effectively Breaks the Network Bottleneck?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI, XunYin Network, and Tsinghua University jointly proposed the ZCube networking architecture. By employing a flat topology and a hybrid single/multi-rail access method, it achieves a 33% cost reduction, over 15% throughput improvement, and a 40.6% reduction in TTFT P99 in a thousand-card inference cluster, effectively solving the structural network congestion problem in PD-separated inference.

relatedArticles.title: Scaling Pain: Large-Scale Coding Agent Inference Practices
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI shares the process of identifying, locating, and fixing three types of abnormal outputs (garbled text, repetition, and rare characters) caused by high concurrency and long contexts in large-scale Coding Agent inference scenarios, and proposes a KV Cache layered storage optimization solution.

relatedArticles.title: Hunyuan Embodied-0.5 Open Source: Designed for Real-World Embodied Agents, a New Foundation for Physical Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent's Hunyuan team has open-sourced the HY-Embodied-0.5 model series, which significantly enhances edge-side model capabilities in 3D spatial perception and physical planning through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and large-scale embodied data.

relatedArticles.title: Alibaba Tongyi Lab Open-Sources Mobile-Agent-v3.5: A Truly "Multi-Platform Ready" Native GUI Agent Foundation Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Alibaba Tongyi Lab has open-sourced the Mobile-Agent-v3.5 and GUI-Owl-1.5 model families, building a unified native GUI Agent foundation across multiple platforms through hybrid data flywheels and multi-platform reinforcement learning.
